<div  class="fl-module fl-module-html fl-html fl-node-b12jqg305uxw" data-node="b12jqg305uxw" aria-label="HTML">
	<style>

<div class="wrap">

      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="control">
      <button id="save" class="secondary" title="Save these selections on this browser">Save</button>

  </div>

  <div class="note">Choose a location and commodity. The table updates automatically.</div>

  <div id="panel" class="card">
    <div id="loading" class="loading hidden">Loading…</div>

    <table id="bids-table" class="hidden" aria-live="polite">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>Commodity</th>
          <th>Delivery</th>
          <th>Cash</th>
          <th>Basis</th>
          <th>Futures</th>
          <th>Change</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody></tbody>

<script>
  // ------- Config -------
  const CONFIG = {
    apiBase: "/wp-json/cv/v1/bids",
    defaultLocation: "madelia", // default to Madelia (no "All" in locations)
    storageKeys: { loc: "cv-cashbid-location", com: "cv-cashbid-commodity" },
    // Alphabetical list of locations (no "All")
    locations: [
      { label: "Hope",           value: "hope" },
      { label: "Jackson",        value: "jackson" },
      { label: "La Salle",       value: "la salle" },
      { label: "Lake Crystal",   value: "lake crystal" },
      { label: "Madelia",        value: "madelia" },
      { label: "Trimont",        value: "trimont" },
      { label: "Vernon Center",  value: "vernon center" }
    ].sort((a,b) => a.label.localeCompare(b.label))
  };

  // ------- State / DOM -------
  const state = {
    location: localStorage.getItem(CONFIG.storageKeys.loc) || CONFIG.defaultLocation,
    commodity: localStorage.getItem(CONFIG.storageKeys.com) || "All",
    rows: [],
  };

  const $loc = document.querySelector('#location');
  const $com = document.querySelector('#commodity');
  const $table = document.querySelector('#bids-table');
  const $tbody = $table.querySelector('tbody');
  const $loading = document.querySelector('#loading');
  const $error = document.querySelector('#error');
  const $save = document.querySelector('#save');

  // ------- Utilities -------
  function populateLocations(){
    $loc.innerHTML = '';
    for (const loc of CONFIG.locations){
      const opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = loc.value;
      opt.textContent = loc.label;
      $loc.appendChild(opt);
    }
    if (![...$loc.options].some(o => o.value === state.location)) {
      state.location = CONFIG.defaultLocation;
    }
    $loc.value = state.location;
  }

  function getCommodityNameFromSymbol(sym){
    if (!sym) return "Unknown";
    const s = String(sym).trim().toUpperCase();
    if (s.startsWith('@C')) return "Corn";
    if (s.startsWith('@S')) return "Soybeans";
    return "Unknown";
  }

  // Turn various shapes/strings into a number or '' (keeps blanks from showing $0.00)
  function toNum(val){
    if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
    if (typeof val === 'number') return isFinite(val) ? val : '';
    if (typeof val === 'string') {
      const cleaned = val.trim().replace(/[^0-9.\-+]/g, '');
      if (cleaned === '') return '';
      const n = Number(cleaned);
      return isNaN(n) ? '' : n;
    }
    if (typeof val === 'object') {
      const nested = val.price ?? val.value ?? val.amount ?? val.quote ?? '';
      return toNum(nested);
    }
    return '';
  }

  // Formatters
  const isNum = (v) => typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v);
  const fmtMoney = (n) => isNum(n) ? `$${n.toFixed(2)}` : '';
  const fmtSigned = (n) => isNum(n) ? ((n >= 0 ? '+' : '') + n.toFixed(2)) : '';
  const text = (t) => (t == null ? '' : String(t));

  // Parse "deliveryDate" values like "Sep 25", "Feb 2026", "Feb", etc. -> Date
  function parseDeliveryToDate(deliveryStr){
    if (!deliveryStr) return null;
    const s = deliveryStr.trim();

    // Maps
    const MONTHS = {
      jan:0,feb:1,mar:2,apr:3,may:4,jun:5,jul:6,aug:7,sep:8,sept:8,oct:9,nov:10,dec:11
    };

    // 1) "MMM YY" or "MMMM YY" (e.g., "Sep 25" => 2025-09-01)
    let m = s.match(/^([A-Za-z]{3,9})\s+(\d{2,4})$/);
    if (m){
      const mon = MONTHS[m[1].slice(0,3).toLowerCase()];
      if (mon != null){
        let yy = Number(m[2]);
        if (yy < 100) yy += 2000; // two-digit year
        return new Date(yy, mon, 1);
      }
    }

    // 2) "MMM" only (assume current year)
    m = s.match(/^([A-Za-z]{3,9})$/);
    if (m){
      const mon = MONTHS[m[1].slice(0,3).toLowerCase()];
      if (mon != null){
        const now = new Date();
        return new Date(now.getFullYear(), mon, 1);
      }
    }

    // 3) "MMM DD" or "MMMM DD" (assume current year)
    m = s.match(/^([A-Za-z]{3,9})\s+(\d{1,2})$/);
    if (m){
      const mon = MONTHS[m[1].slice(0,3).toLowerCase()];
      const day = Number(m[2]);
      if (mon != null && day){
        const now = new Date();
        return new Date(now.getFullYear(), mon, day);
      }
    }

    // 4) "MMM DD, YYYY" or "MMM YYYY"
    m = s.match(/^([A-Za-z]{3,9})\s+(\d{1,2}),\s*(\d{4})$/);
    if (m){
      const mon = MONTHS[m[1].slice(0,3).toLowerCase()];
      const day = Number(m[2]);
      const yr  = Number(m[3]);
      if (mon != null && day && yr) return new Date(yr, mon, day);
    }
    m = s.match(/^([A-Za-z]{3,9})\s+(\d{4})$/);
    if (m){
      const mon = MONTHS[m[1].slice(0,3).toLowerCase()];
      const yr  = Number(m[2]);
      if (mon != null && yr) return new Date(yr, mon, 1);
    }

    // 5) Fallback: try native Date (may be locale dependent)
    const d = new Date(s);
    return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
  }

  function normalizeRow(row){
    const get = (...keys) => {
      for (const k of keys){
        if (row && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(row, k)) return row[k];
      }
      return undefined;
    };

    // Keys per your API note: deliveryDate, cashBid
    const delivery = get('deliveryDate','delivery','deliveryEnd','DeliveryEnd','Delivery') || '';
    const symbol   = get('symbol','SYMBOL','Symbol','futures','Futures') || '';
    const commodity = getCommodityNameFromSymbol(symbol);

    // Numeric fields (robust to strings/objects)
    const cash    = toNum(get('cashBid','cashPrice','CashBid','CashPrice','cash','Cash'));
    const basis   = toNum(get('basis','Basis','BASIS_PRICE'));
    const futures = toNum(get(
      'futuresQuote','FuturesQuote','FUTURES_QUOTE',
      'futuresPrice','FuturesPrice','futures_price',
      'board','boardPrice','board_price',
      'futures','Futures'
    ));
    const change  = toNum(get('change','Change','futuresChange','FuturesChange','FUTURES_CHANGE','priceChange','PriceChange','futures_change'));

    const deliveryDate = parseDeliveryToDate(String(delivery));

    return { symbol, commodity, delivery, deliveryDate, cash, basis, futures, change };
  }

  // Build commodity select (fixed: All / Corn / Soybeans already present)
  function syncCommoditySelectFromRows(rows){
    const haveCorn = rows.some(r => r.commodity === 'Corn');
    const haveSoy  = rows.some(r => r.commodity === 'Soybeans');

    // Keep existing options, just disable ones not present
    for (const opt of [...$com.options]){
      if (opt.value === 'Corn')  opt.disabled = !haveCorn;
      if (opt.value === 'Soybeans') opt.disabled = !haveSoy;
    }

    // If current selection is disabled, fall back to All
    if ($com.selectedOptions[0]?.disabled){
      $com.value = 'All';
      state.commodity = 'All';
    }
  }

  // Sort: Corn first, Soybeans second, then by delivery month/year ascending
  function sortForGrouping(arr){
    const order = { 'Corn': 0, 'Soybeans': 1, 'Unknown': 2 };
    return arr.slice().sort((a,b) => {
      const c = (order[a.commodity] ?? 99) - (order[b.commodity] ?? 99);
      if (c) return c;

      // Compare by deliveryDate if both parsed
      if (a.deliveryDate && b.deliveryDate){
        return a.deliveryDate - b.deliveryDate;
      } else if (a.deliveryDate && !b.deliveryDate){
        return -1;
      } else if (!a.deliveryDate && b.deliveryDate){
        return 1;
      }

      // Fallback secondary sort: by delivery text then symbol
      const d = (a.delivery || '').localeCompare(b.delivery || '');
      if (d) return d;
      return (a.symbol || '').localeCompare(b.symbol || '');
    });
  }

  function renderTable(){
    $tbody.innerHTML = '';
    let filtered = state.rows;

    if (state.commodity !== 'All'){
      filtered = filtered.filter(r => r.commodity === state.commodity);
    }

    const rows = sortForGrouping(filtered);

    if (!rows.length){
      $table.classList.remove('hidden');
      const tr = document.createElement('tr');
      const td = document.createElement('td');
      td.colSpan = 6; td.textContent = 'No bids found.'; td.className = 'note';
      tr.appendChild(td); $tbody.appendChild(tr);
      return;
    }

    for (const r of rows){
      const tr = document.createElement('tr');
      tr.innerHTML = `
        <td>${r.symbol ? `${r.symbol} – ${r.commodity}` : r.commodity}</td>
        <td>${text(r.delivery)}</td>
        <td>${fmtMoney(r.cash)}</td>
        <td>${fmtSigned(r.basis)}</td>
        <td>${fmtMoney(r.futures)}</td>
        <td>${fmtSigned(r.change)}</td>
      `;
      $tbody.appendChild(tr);
    }
    $table.classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  async function loadBids(){
    $error.classList.add('hidden');
    $table.classList.add('hidden');
    $loading.classList.remove('hidden');
    $tbody.innerHTML = '';
    const loc = $loc.value || CONFIG.defaultLocation;
    state.location = loc;

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${CONFIG.apiBase}?location=${encodeURIComponent(loc)}`, { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' } });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}: ${res.statusText}`);

      const data = await res.json();
      const arr = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data?.bids || data?.Bid || data?.results || []);
      if (!Array.isArray(arr)) throw new Error('Unexpected API shape. Expected an array of bids.');

      state.rows = arr.map(normalizeRow);

      // Update commodity dropdown enable/disable based on data
      syncCommoditySelectFromRows(state.rows);

      renderTable();
    } catch (err){
      console.error(err);
      $error.textContent = `Failed to load bids for "${loc}". ${err.message}.`;
      $error.classList.remove('hidden');
    } finally {
      $loading.classList.add('hidden');
    }
  }

  // ------- Events -------
  $loc.addEventListener('change', () => {
    // Persist selection and auto-load
    localStorage.setItem(CONFIG.storageKeys.loc, ($loc.value || CONFIG.defaultLocation));
    loadBids();
  });

  $com.addEventListener('change', () => {
    state.commodity = $com.value;
    localStorage.setItem(CONFIG.storageKeys.com, state.commodity);
    renderTable(); // no refetch needed—client-side filter
  });

  $save.addEventListener('click', () => {
    localStorage.setItem(CONFIG.storageKeys.loc, ($loc.value || CONFIG.defaultLocation));

<script>
  // ------- Config -------
  const CONFIG = {
    apiBase: "/wp-json/cv/v1/bids",
    defaultLocation: "madelia", // default to Madelia (no "All" in locations)
    storageKeys: { loc: "cv-cashbid-location", com: "cv-cashbid-commodity" },
    // Alphabetical list of locations (no "All")
    locations: [
      { label: "Hope",           value: "hope" },
      { label: "Jackson",        value: "jackson" },
      { label: "La Salle",       value: "la salle" },
      { label: "Lake Crystal",   value: "lake crystal" },
      { label: "Madelia",        value: "madelia" },
      { label: "Trimont",        value: "trimont" },
      { label: "Vernon Center",  value: "vernon center" }
    ].sort((a,b) => a.label.localeCompare(b.label))
  };

  // ------- State / DOM -------
  const state = {
    location: localStorage.getItem(CONFIG.storageKeys.loc) || CONFIG.defaultLocation,
    commodity: localStorage.getItem(CONFIG.storageKeys.com) || "All",
    rows: [],
  };

  const $loc = document.querySelector('#location');
  const $com = document.querySelector('#commodity');
  const $table = document.querySelector('#bids-table');
  const $tbody = $table.querySelector('tbody');
  const $loading = document.querySelector('#loading');
  const $error = document.querySelector('#error');
  const $save = document.querySelector('#save');

  // ------- Utilities -------
  function populateLocations(){
    $loc.innerHTML = '';
    for (const loc of CONFIG.locations){
      const opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = loc.value;
      opt.textContent = loc.label;
      $loc.appendChild(opt);
    }
    if (![...$loc.options].some(o => o.value === state.location)) {
      state.location = CONFIG.defaultLocation;
    }
    $loc.value = state.location;
  }

  function getCommodityNameFromSymbol(sym){
    if (!sym) return "Unknown";
    const s = String(sym).trim().toUpperCase();
    if (s.startsWith('@C')) return "Corn";
    if (s.startsWith('@S')) return "Soybeans";
    return "Unknown";
  }

  // Turn various shapes/strings into a number or '' (keeps blanks from showing $0.00)
  function toNum(val){
    if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
    if (typeof val === 'number') return isFinite(val) ? val : '';
    if (typeof val === 'string') {
      const cleaned = val.trim().replace(/[^0-9.\-+]/g, '');
      if (cleaned === '') return '';
      const n = Number(cleaned);
      return isNaN(n) ? '' : n;
    }
    if (typeof val === 'object') {
      const nested = val.price ?? val.value ?? val.amount ?? val.quote ?? '';
      return toNum(nested);
    }
    return '';
  }

  // Formatters
  const isNum = (v) => typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v);
  const fmtMoney = (n) => isNum(n) ? `$${n.toFixed(2)}` : '';
  const fmtSigned = (n) => isNum(n) ? ((n >= 0 ? '+' : '') + n.toFixed(2)) : '';
  const text = (t) => (t == null ? '' : String(t));

  // Parse "deliveryDate" values like "Sep 25", "Feb 2026", "Feb", etc. -> Date
  function parseDeliveryToDate(deliveryStr){
    if (!deliveryStr) return null;
    const s = deliveryStr.trim();

    // Maps
    const MONTHS = {
      jan:0,feb:1,mar:2,apr:3,may:4,jun:5,jul:6,aug:7,sep:8,sept:8,oct:9,nov:10,dec:11
    };

    // 1) "MMM YY" or "MMMM YY" (e.g., "Sep 25" => 2025-09-01)
    let m = s.match(/^([A-Za-z]{3,9})\s+(\d{2,4})$/);
    if (m){
      const mon = MONTHS[m[1].slice(0,3).toLowerCase()];
      if (mon != null){
        let yy = Number(m[2]);
        if (yy < 100) yy += 2000; // two-digit year
        return new Date(yy, mon, 1);
      }
    }

    // 2) "MMM" only (assume current year)
    m = s.match(/^([A-Za-z]{3,9})$/);
    if (m){
      const mon = MONTHS[m[1].slice(0,3).toLowerCase()];
      if (mon != null){
        const now = new Date();
        return new Date(now.getFullYear(), mon, 1);
      }
    }

    // 3) "MMM DD" or "MMMM DD" (assume current year)
    m = s.match(/^([A-Za-z]{3,9})\s+(\d{1,2})$/);
    if (m){
      const mon = MONTHS[m[1].slice(0,3).toLowerCase()];
      const day = Number(m[2]);
      if (mon != null && day){
        const now = new Date();
        return new Date(now.getFullYear(), mon, day);
      }
    }

    // 4) "MMM DD, YYYY" or "MMM YYYY"
    m = s.match(/^([A-Za-z]{3,9})\s+(\d{1,2}),\s*(\d{4})$/);
    if (m){
      const mon = MONTHS[m[1].slice(0,3).toLowerCase()];
      const day = Number(m[2]);
      const yr  = Number(m[3]);
      if (mon != null && day && yr) return new Date(yr, mon, day);
    }
    m = s.match(/^([A-Za-z]{3,9})\s+(\d{4})$/);
    if (m){
      const mon = MONTHS[m[1].slice(0,3).toLowerCase()];
      const yr  = Number(m[2]);
      if (mon != null && yr) return new Date(yr, mon, 1);
    }

    // 5) Fallback: try native Date (may be locale dependent)
    const d = new Date(s);
    return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
  }

  function normalizeRow(row){
    const get = (...keys) => {
      for (const k of keys){
        if (row && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(row, k)) return row[k];
      }
      return undefined;
    };

    // Keys per your API note: deliveryDate, cashBid
    const delivery = get('deliveryDate','delivery','deliveryEnd','DeliveryEnd','Delivery') || '';
    const symbol   = get('symbol','SYMBOL','Symbol','futures','Futures') || '';
    const commodity = getCommodityNameFromSymbol(symbol);

    // Numeric fields (robust to strings/objects)
    const cash    = toNum(get('cashBid','cashPrice','CashBid','CashPrice','cash','Cash'));
    const basis   = toNum(get('basis','Basis','BASIS_PRICE'));
    const futures = toNum(get(
      'futuresQuote','FuturesQuote','FUTURES_QUOTE',
      'futuresPrice','FuturesPrice','futures_price',
      'board','boardPrice','board_price',
      'futures','Futures'
    ));
    const change  = toNum(get('change','Change','futuresChange','FuturesChange','FUTURES_CHANGE','priceChange','PriceChange','futures_change'));

    const deliveryDate = parseDeliveryToDate(String(delivery));

    return { symbol, commodity, delivery, deliveryDate, cash, basis, futures, change };
  }

  // Build commodity select (fixed: All / Corn / Soybeans already present)
  function syncCommoditySelectFromRows(rows){
    const haveCorn = rows.some(r => r.commodity === 'Corn');
    const haveSoy  = rows.some(r => r.commodity === 'Soybeans');

    // Keep existing options, just disable ones not present
    for (const opt of [...$com.options]){
      if (opt.value === 'Corn')  opt.disabled = !haveCorn;
      if (opt.value === 'Soybeans') opt.disabled = !haveSoy;
    }

    // If current selection is disabled, fall back to All
    if ($com.selectedOptions[0]?.disabled){
      $com.value = 'All';
      state.commodity = 'All';
    }
  }

  // Sort: Corn first, Soybeans second, then by delivery month/year ascending
  function sortForGrouping(arr){
    const order = { 'Corn': 0, 'Soybeans': 1, 'Unknown': 2 };
    return arr.slice().sort((a,b) => {
      const c = (order[a.commodity] ?? 99) - (order[b.commodity] ?? 99);
      if (c) return c;

      // Compare by deliveryDate if both parsed
      if (a.deliveryDate && b.deliveryDate){
        return a.deliveryDate - b.deliveryDate;
      } else if (a.deliveryDate && !b.deliveryDate){
        return -1;
      } else if (!a.deliveryDate && b.deliveryDate){
        return 1;
      }

      // Fallback secondary sort: by delivery text then symbol
      const d = (a.delivery || '').localeCompare(b.delivery || '');
      if (d) return d;
      return (a.symbol || '').localeCompare(b.symbol || '');
    });
  }

  function renderTable(){
    $tbody.innerHTML = '';
    let filtered = state.rows;

    if (state.commodity !== 'All'){
      filtered = filtered.filter(r => r.commodity === state.commodity);
    }

    const rows = sortForGrouping(filtered);

    if (!rows.length){
      $table.classList.remove('hidden');
      const tr = document.createElement('tr');
      const td = document.createElement('td');
      td.colSpan = 6; td.textContent = 'No bids found.'; td.className = 'note';
      tr.appendChild(td); $tbody.appendChild(tr);
      return;
    }

    for (const r of rows){
      const tr = document.createElement('tr');
      tr.innerHTML = `
        <td>${r.symbol ? `${r.symbol} – ${r.commodity}` : r.commodity}</td>
        <td>${text(r.delivery)}</td>
        <td>${fmtMoney(r.cash)}</td>
        <td>${fmtSigned(r.basis)}</td>
        <td>${fmtMoney(r.futures)}</td>
        <td>${fmtSigned(r.change)}</td>
      `;
      $tbody.appendChild(tr);
    }
    $table.classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  async function loadBids(){
    $error.classList.add('hidden');
    $table.classList.add('hidden');
    $loading.classList.remove('hidden');
    $tbody.innerHTML = '';
    const loc = $loc.value || CONFIG.defaultLocation;
    state.location = loc;

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${CONFIG.apiBase}?location=${encodeURIComponent(loc)}`, { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' } });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}: ${res.statusText}`);

      const data = await res.json();
      const arr = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data?.bids || data?.Bid || data?.results || []);
      if (!Array.isArray(arr)) throw new Error('Unexpected API shape. Expected an array of bids.');

      state.rows = arr.map(normalizeRow);

      // Update commodity dropdown enable/disable based on data
      syncCommoditySelectFromRows(state.rows);

      renderTable();
    } catch (err){
      console.error(err);
      $error.textContent = `Failed to load bids for "${loc}". ${err.message}.`;
      $error.classList.remove('hidden');
    } finally {
      $loading.classList.add('hidden');
    }
  }

  // ------- Events -------
  $loc.addEventListener('change', () => {
    // Persist selection and auto-load
    localStorage.setItem(CONFIG.storageKeys.loc, ($loc.value || CONFIG.defaultLocation));
    loadBids();
  });

  $com.addEventListener('change', () => {
    state.commodity = $com.value;
    localStorage.setItem(CONFIG.storageKeys.com, state.commodity);
    renderTable(); // no refetch needed—client-side filter
  });

  $save.addEventListener('click', () => {
    localStorage.setItem(CONFIG.storageKeys.loc, ($loc.value || CONFIG.defaultLocation));
    localStorage.setItem(CONFIG.storageKeys.com, $com.value);
    alert('Saved!');
  });

  // ------- Init -------
  populateLocations();
  $com.value = state.commodity; // restore last commodity choice
  loadBids();                   // auto-load on page load
</script></div>

    function bcPostNews(pl, appendHash) {
        var feedElm = document.getElementById('feed');

        var data = {'feed[]':feed,'_fullhost':fullHost,'module': selModule,'rformat': rformat};
        var myForm = document.createElement("form");
        myForm.method="post";
        myForm.action = '//'+ pl + '.websol.barchart.com';
        if (appendHash) {
            myForm.action += '#' + encodeURIComponent(appendHash);
        }
        for (var k in data) {
        var myInput = document.createElement("input") ;
        myInput.setAttribute("name", k) ;
        myInput.setAttribute("value", data[k]);
        myForm.appendChild(myInput) ;
        }
        document.body.appendChild(myForm) ;
        myForm.submit();
        document.body.removeChild(myForm) ;
    }

	<script type="text/javascript">

	function hasClass(element, cls) {
		if(typeof(element) == 'undefined'){ return false; }
  	return (' ' + element.className + ' ').indexOf(' ' + cls + ' ') > -1;
	}

	function hasId(element, id){
		if(typeof(element) == 'undefined'){ return false; }
		return (' ' + element.id + ' ').indexOf( ' ' + id + ' ') > -1;
	}

	function showElement(id) {
    document.getElementById(id).style.display = 'block';
	}

	function hideElement(id) {
		document.getElementById(id).style.display = 'none';
	}

	// get closest parent
	function getClosest(el, tag) {
	  // this is necessary since nodeName is always in upper case
	  tag = tag.toUpperCase();
	  do {
	    if (el.nodeName === tag) {
	      // tag name is found! let's return it. :)
	      return el;
	    }
	  } while (el = el.parentNode);

	  // not found :(
	  return null;
	}

	// verify if id is a parent of el
	function isParent(el, parentIDorClass) {
		if(typeof(el) == 'undefined'){ return false; }
		do {
			if(hasId(el, parentIDorClass) || hasClass(el,parentIDorClass)) {
				return el;
			}
		} while (el = el.parentNode);
		return null;
	}

	// Check if element of parent is actually hidden
	function isHidden(el) {
		do {
			if(typeof(el.style) != 'undefined' && el.style.display == 'none') {
				return true;
			}
		} while (el = el.parentNode);
		return null;
	}

	// IE8 fiendly preventDefault
	function preventDefault(e) {
		var result = (e.preventDefault()) || null;
		if(!result) {
			e.returnValue = false;
		}
		return result;
	}

	// IE8 friendly getAttribute
	function getAttribute(el, attr) {
    var result = (el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute(attr)) || null;
    if(!result) {
        var attrs = el.attributes;
        var length = attrs.length;
        for(var i = 0; i < length; i++)
            if(attrs[i].nodeName === attr)
                result = attrs[i].nodeValue;
    }
    return result;
  }

  // Generic function 
  var getElementsByClassName = function (className, tag, elm){
		if (document.getElementsByClassName) {
			getElementsByClassName = function (className, tag, elm) {
				elm = elm || document;
				var elements = elm.getElementsByClassName(className),
					nodeName = (tag)? new RegExp("\\b" + tag + "\\b", "i") : null,
					returnElements = [],
					current;
				for(var i=0, il=elements.length; i<il; i+=1){
					current = elements[i];
					if(!nodeName || nodeName.test(current.nodeName)) {
						returnElements.push(current);
					}
				}
				return returnElements;
			};
		}
		else if (document.evaluate) {
			getElementsByClassName = function (className, tag, elm) {
				tag = tag || "*";
				elm = elm || document;
				var classes = className.split(" "),
					classesToCheck = "",
					xhtmlNamespace = "http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml",
					namespaceResolver = (document.documentElement.namespaceURI === xhtmlNamespace)? xhtmlNamespace : null,
					returnElements = [],
					elements,
					node;
				for(var j=0, jl=classes.length; j<jl; j+=1){
					classesToCheck += "[contains(concat(' ', @class, ' '), ' " + classes[j] + " ')]";
				}
				try	{
					elements = document.evaluate(".//" + tag + classesToCheck, elm, namespaceResolver, 0, null);
				}
				catch (e) {
					elements = document.evaluate(".//" + tag + classesToCheck, elm, null, 0, null);
				}
				while ((node = elements.iterateNext())) {
					returnElements.push(node);
				}
				return returnElements;
			};
		}
		else {
			getElementsByClassName = function (className, tag, elm) {
				tag = tag || "*";
				elm = elm || document;
				var classes = className.split(" "),
					classesToCheck = [],
					elements = (tag === "*" && elm.all)? elm.all : elm.getElementsByTagName(tag),
					current,
					returnElements = [],
					match;
				for(var k=0, kl=classes.length; k<kl; k+=1){
					classesToCheck.push(new RegExp("(^|\\s)" + classes[k] + "(\\s|$)"));
				}
				for(var l=0, ll=elements.length; l<ll; l+=1){
					current = elements[l];
					match = false;
					for(var m=0, ml=classesToCheck.length; m<ml; m+=1){
						match = classesToCheck[m].test(current.className);
						if (!match) {
							break;
						}
					}
					if (match) {
						returnElements.push(current);
					}
				}
				return returnElements;
			};
		}
		return getElementsByClassName(className, tag, elm);
	};

  select, button { border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius: .5rem; padding: .5rem .75rem; font-size: .95rem; background:white; }
  button { background: var(--brand); color:white; border-color: var(--brand); cursor:pointer; }
  button.secondary { background:white; color: var(--brand); }

  .note { color: var(--muted); font-size: .9rem; margin-bottom:1rem; }

  .card { background: var(--bg); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 1rem; margin-top: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.03); }

  tbody tr:hover { background: #f9fafb; }

  .loading { padding:1rem; color: var(--muted); }

<div class="wrap">
  <div class="controls">
    <div class="control">
      <label for="location">Location</label>
      <select id="location"></select>
    </div>
    <div class="control">
      <label for="commodity">Commodity</label>
      <select id="commodity">
        <option value="All">All</option>
        <option value="Corn">Corn</option>
        <option value="Soybeans">Soybeans</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="control">
      <button id="save" class="secondary" title="Save these selections on this browser">Save</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="note">Choose a location and commodity. The table updates automatically.</div>

  <div id="panel" class="card">
    <div id="loading" class="loading hidden">Loading…</div>
    <div id="error" class="error hidden"></div>
    <table id="bids-table" class="hidden" aria-live="polite">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>Commodity</th>
          <th>Delivery</th>
          <th>Cash</th>
          <th>Basis</th>
          <th>Futures</th>
          <th>Change</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody></tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  // ------- Config -------
  const CONFIG = {
    apiBase: "/wp-json/cv/v1/bids",
    defaultLocation: "madelia", // default to Madelia (no "All" in locations)
    storageKeys: { loc: "cv-cashbid-location", com: "cv-cashbid-commodity" },
    // Alphabetical list of locations (no "All")
    locations: [
      { label: "Hope",           value: "hope" },
      { label: "Jackson",        value: "jackson" },
      { label: "La Salle",       value: "la salle" },
      { label: "Lake Crystal",   value: "lake crystal" },
      { label: "Madelia",        value: "madelia" },
      { label: "Trimont",        value: "trimont" },
      { label: "Vernon Center",  value: "vernon center" }
    ].sort((a,b) => a.label.localeCompare(b.label))
  };

  // ------- State / DOM -------
  const state = {
    location: localStorage.getItem(CONFIG.storageKeys.loc) || CONFIG.defaultLocation,
    commodity: localStorage.getItem(CONFIG.storageKeys.com) || "All",
    rows: [],
  };

  const $loc = document.querySelector('#location');
  const $com = document.querySelector('#commodity');
  const $table = document.querySelector('#bids-table');
  const $tbody = $table.querySelector('tbody');
  const $loading = document.querySelector('#loading');
  const $error = document.querySelector('#error');
  const $save = document.querySelector('#save');

  // ------- Utilities -------
  function populateLocations(){
    $loc.innerHTML = '';
    for (const loc of CONFIG.locations){
      const opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = loc.value;
      opt.textContent = loc.label;
      $loc.appendChild(opt);
    }
    if (![...$loc.options].some(o => o.value === state.location)) {
      state.location = CONFIG.defaultLocation;
    }
    $loc.value = state.location;
  }

  function getCommodityNameFromSymbol(sym){
    if (!sym) return "Unknown";
    const s = String(sym).trim().toUpperCase();
    if (s.startsWith('@C')) return "Corn";
    if (s.startsWith('@S')) return "Soybeans";
    return "Unknown";
  }

  // Turn various shapes/strings into a number or '' (keeps blanks from showing $0.00)
  function toNum(val){
    if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
    if (typeof val === 'number') return isFinite(val) ? val : '';
    if (typeof val === 'string') {
      const cleaned = val.trim().replace(/[^0-9.\-+]/g, '');
      if (cleaned === '') return '';
      const n = Number(cleaned);
      return isNaN(n) ? '' : n;
    }
    if (typeof val === 'object') {
      const nested = val.price ?? val.value ?? val.amount ?? val.quote ?? '';
      return toNum(nested);
    }
    return '';
  }

  // Formatters
  const isNum = (v) => typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v);
  const fmtMoney = (n) => isNum(n) ? `$${n.toFixed(2)}` : '';
  const fmtSigned = (n) => isNum(n) ? ((n >= 0 ? '+' : '') + n.toFixed(2)) : '';
  const text = (t) => (t == null ? '' : String(t));

  // Parse "deliveryDate" values like "Sep 25", "Feb 2026", "Feb", etc. -> Date
  function parseDeliveryToDate(deliveryStr){
    if (!deliveryStr) return null;
    const s = deliveryStr.trim();

    // Maps
    const MONTHS = {
      jan:0,feb:1,mar:2,apr:3,may:4,jun:5,jul:6,aug:7,sep:8,sept:8,oct:9,nov:10,dec:11
    };

    // 1) "MMM YY" or "MMMM YY" (e.g., "Sep 25" => 2025-09-01)
    let m = s.match(/^([A-Za-z]{3,9})\s+(\d{2,4})$/);
    if (m){
      const mon = MONTHS[m[1].slice(0,3).toLowerCase()];
      if (mon != null){
        let yy = Number(m[2]);
        if (yy < 100) yy += 2000; // two-digit year
        return new Date(yy, mon, 1);
      }
    }

    // 2) "MMM" only (assume current year)
    m = s.match(/^([A-Za-z]{3,9})$/);
    if (m){
      const mon = MONTHS[m[1].slice(0,3).toLowerCase()];
      if (mon != null){
        const now = new Date();
        return new Date(now.getFullYear(), mon, 1);
      }
    }

    // 3) "MMM DD" or "MMMM DD" (assume current year)
    m = s.match(/^([A-Za-z]{3,9})\s+(\d{1,2})$/);
    if (m){
      const mon = MONTHS[m[1].slice(0,3).toLowerCase()];
      const day = Number(m[2]);
      if (mon != null && day){
        const now = new Date();
        return new Date(now.getFullYear(), mon, day);
      }
    }

    // 4) "MMM DD, YYYY" or "MMM YYYY"
    m = s.match(/^([A-Za-z]{3,9})\s+(\d{1,2}),\s*(\d{4})$/);
    if (m){
      const mon = MONTHS[m[1].slice(0,3).toLowerCase()];
      const day = Number(m[2]);
      const yr  = Number(m[3]);
      if (mon != null && day && yr) return new Date(yr, mon, day);
    }
    m = s.match(/^([A-Za-z]{3,9})\s+(\d{4})$/);
    if (m){
      const mon = MONTHS[m[1].slice(0,3).toLowerCase()];
      const yr  = Number(m[2]);
      if (mon != null && yr) return new Date(yr, mon, 1);
    }

    // 5) Fallback: try native Date (may be locale dependent)
    const d = new Date(s);
    return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
  }

  function normalizeRow(row){
    const get = (...keys) => {
      for (const k of keys){
        if (row && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(row, k)) return row[k];
      }
      return undefined;
    };

    // Keys per your API note: deliveryDate, cashBid
    const delivery = get('deliveryDate','delivery','deliveryEnd','DeliveryEnd','Delivery') || '';
    const symbol   = get('symbol','SYMBOL','Symbol','futures','Futures') || '';
    const commodity = getCommodityNameFromSymbol(symbol);

    // Numeric fields (robust to strings/objects)
    const cash    = toNum(get('cashBid','cashPrice','CashBid','CashPrice','cash','Cash'));
    const basis   = toNum(get('basis','Basis','BASIS_PRICE'));
    const futures = toNum(get(
      'futuresQuote','FuturesQuote','FUTURES_QUOTE',
      'futuresPrice','FuturesPrice','futures_price',
      'board','boardPrice','board_price',
      'futures','Futures'
    ));
    const change  = toNum(get('change','Change','futuresChange','FuturesChange','FUTURES_CHANGE','priceChange','PriceChange','futures_change'));

    const deliveryDate = parseDeliveryToDate(String(delivery));

    return { symbol, commodity, delivery, deliveryDate, cash, basis, futures, change };
  }

  // Build commodity select (fixed: All / Corn / Soybeans already present)
  function syncCommoditySelectFromRows(rows){
    const haveCorn = rows.some(r => r.commodity === 'Corn');
    const haveSoy  = rows.some(r => r.commodity === 'Soybeans');

    // Keep existing options, just disable ones not present
    for (const opt of [...$com.options]){
      if (opt.value === 'Corn')  opt.disabled = !haveCorn;
      if (opt.value === 'Soybeans') opt.disabled = !haveSoy;
    }

    // If current selection is disabled, fall back to All
    if ($com.selectedOptions[0]?.disabled){
      $com.value = 'All';
      state.commodity = 'All';
    }
  }

  // Sort: Corn first, Soybeans second, then by delivery month/year ascending
  function sortForGrouping(arr){
    const order = { 'Corn': 0, 'Soybeans': 1, 'Unknown': 2 };
    return arr.slice().sort((a,b) => {
      const c = (order[a.commodity] ?? 99) - (order[b.commodity] ?? 99);
      if (c) return c;

      // Compare by deliveryDate if both parsed
      if (a.deliveryDate && b.deliveryDate){
        return a.deliveryDate - b.deliveryDate;
      } else if (a.deliveryDate && !b.deliveryDate){
        return -1;
      } else if (!a.deliveryDate && b.deliveryDate){
        return 1;
      }

      // Fallback secondary sort: by delivery text then symbol
      const d = (a.delivery || '').localeCompare(b.delivery || '');
      if (d) return d;
      return (a.symbol || '').localeCompare(b.symbol || '');
    });
  }

  function renderTable(){
    $tbody.innerHTML = '';
    let filtered = state.rows;

    if (state.commodity !== 'All'){
      filtered = filtered.filter(r => r.commodity === state.commodity);
    }

    const rows = sortForGrouping(filtered);

    if (!rows.length){
      $table.classList.remove('hidden');
      const tr = document.createElement('tr');
      const td = document.createElement('td');
      td.colSpan = 6; td.textContent = 'No bids found.'; td.className = 'note';
      tr.appendChild(td); $tbody.appendChild(tr);
      return;
    }

    for (const r of rows){
      const tr = document.createElement('tr');
      tr.innerHTML = `
        <td>${r.symbol ? `${r.symbol} – ${r.commodity}` : r.commodity}</td>
        <td>${text(r.delivery)}</td>
        <td>${fmtMoney(r.cash)}</td>
        <td>${fmtSigned(r.basis)}</td>
        <td>${fmtMoney(r.futures)}</td>
        <td>${fmtSigned(r.change)}</td>
      `;
      $tbody.appendChild(tr);
    }
    $table.classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  async function loadBids(){
    $error.classList.add('hidden');
    $table.classList.add('hidden');
    $loading.classList.remove('hidden');
    $tbody.innerHTML = '';
    const loc = $loc.value || CONFIG.defaultLocation;
    state.location = loc;

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${CONFIG.apiBase}?location=${encodeURIComponent(loc)}`, { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' } });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}: ${res.statusText}`);

      const data = await res.json();
      const arr = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data?.bids || data?.Bid || data?.results || []);
      if (!Array.isArray(arr)) throw new Error('Unexpected API shape. Expected an array of bids.');

      state.rows = arr.map(normalizeRow);

      // Update commodity dropdown enable/disable based on data
      syncCommoditySelectFromRows(state.rows);

      renderTable();
    } catch (err){
      console.error(err);
      $error.textContent = `Failed to load bids for "${loc}". ${err.message}.`;
      $error.classList.remove('hidden');
    } finally {
      $loading.classList.add('hidden');
    }
  }

  // ------- Events -------
  $loc.addEventListener('change', () => {
    // Persist selection and auto-load
    localStorage.setItem(CONFIG.storageKeys.loc, ($loc.value || CONFIG.defaultLocation));
    loadBids();
  });

  $com.addEventListener('change', () => {
    state.commodity = $com.value;
    localStorage.setItem(CONFIG.storageKeys.com, state.commodity);
    renderTable(); // no refetch needed—client-side filter
  });

  $save.addEventListener('click', () => {
    localStorage.setItem(CONFIG.storageKeys.loc, ($loc.value || CONFIG.defaultLocation));
    localStorage.setItem(CONFIG.storageKeys.com, $com.value);
    alert('Saved!');
  });

  // ------- Init -------
  populateLocations();
  $com.value = state.commodity; // restore last commodity choice
  loadBids();                   // auto-load on page load
</script></div>
</div>
